items.quote: Direct reports said that Tormon Garuen headed media interviews and press conferences, setting priorities for several teams.
Several respondents noted that Tormon handled the redesign of the citizen journey for permits competently within his team.
Several respondents noted that Tormon Garuen assisted with bilateral negotiations on the water agreement.
Direct reports said that Tormon supported senior colleagues on the division's budget planning.
Several respondents noted that Tormon Garuen led work with three sister agencies on a shared problem across the department.
